run_detectFaces_main: run detectFaces.py to track faces in a video and output per-speaker face crops, landmarks, and tracked videos
create_face2head: create expanded square face bounding boxes from detected rectangles using a configurable scale factor
create_bb_intersection_over_union: compute the intersection-over-union score between two bounding boxes for speaker tracking association
run_detectFaces_cli: run the detectFaces CLI with --video_input_path, --output_path, --detect_every_N_frame, --scalar_face_detection, and --number_of_speakers arguments
summarize_detectFaces_main: summarize the detectFaces main pipeline that detects faces with MTCNN, tracks speakers via IoU, crops faces, saves landmarks as npz, and writes per-speaker videos
